subject: Renewal kickoff & capacity uplift — mutual action plan and QBR windows
messages:
From: Sarah Kim <sarah@nimbuspay.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@nimbuspay.com>
Date: Thu, 08 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff — looking to confirm onramp timing and capacity

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for a great Q1 check-in. As we discussed, NimbusPay is expecting a seasonal increase in transaction volume starting in late July and we'd like to confirm our renewal plan early so engineering and finance can align. High-level asks:

- Target commit: +40% token throughput starting 2025-08-01 (estimate; final numbers below)
- Consideration for a 12-month term vs 24-month (pricing team will prefer 24 but we need flexibility)
- QBR to review SLA and burst support during peak windows

Can you kick off a mutual action plan and propose 2–3 QBR windows for a review with our execs? We can share usage forecasts and legal will push any redlines after the MAP.

Attaching an initial usage export and a short summary. Proposed stakeholders: myself, Tom Alvarez (infra lead), Olga Petrov (Redwood AE), a Redwood solutions engineer, and legal.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Kim
Head of Platform Ops, NimbusPay

Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — looking to confirm onramp timing and capacity

Hi Sarah — appreciate the context and the export. Happy to run the MAP and lock in QBR windows. Proposed next steps from our side:

1) Internal intake & capacity check (we'll confirm GPU pool fit and burst lanes) — owner: Karthik (ETA 48 hrs)
2) Draft mutual action plan + initial pricing table (Olga/Marissa) — ETA 2 business days
3) QBR scheduling: please pick one of these slots (all PDT):
   - Tue 2025-05-20 10:00–11:00
   - Wed 2025-05-21 15:00–16:00
   - Thu 2025-05-22 08:30–09:30

Can you confirm which slot works for your execs? For the MAP we recommend capturing: target throughput, preferred term, desired SLA uplift, and a short roll-forward plan for August burst.

I attached a one-page MAP template (Renewal_MAP_v1.pdf) to help speed the draft. Legal/Procurement questions are normal — happy to partner through redlines once we have the MAP locked.

Olga Petrov

olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

Date: Fri, 09 May 2025 10:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — looking to confirm onramp timing and capacity

Adding some technical context after I reviewed the usage export. Quick notes:

- Baseline TPS and average sequence lengths mean the requested +40% translates to ~2.2x peak GPU utilization if unbatched. We should plan for:
  * Scheduled batching policies for non-latency-critical routes
  * Prefix cache on common requests to shave token costs
- Burst lanes: we can provision a dedicated pool for the seasonal window but it'd be best if NimbusPay can allow a short warm-up period (24–48 hrs) before peak.
- Ops ask: provide us with a weekly forecast CSV (sample in MAP) — that allows autoscaler rules to pre-warm capacity.

I'll follow up with a short capacity-assessment note by EOD Monday. For QBR slots I prefer Tue 5/20 or Wed 5/21.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Dedicated Products, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Kim <sarah@nimbuspay.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@nimbuspay.com>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — looking to confirm onramp timing and capacity

Legal & pricing note from my desk:

- Pricing: 12-month vs 24-month: we can provide a 6–8% annualized discount for 24-month. If NimbusPay needs term flexibility, we can propose a staircase commit with a shorter notice for adjusting capacity in months 1–3.
- Billing: we'll keep monthly invoicing but can add a committed-minimum credit with overage true-up to simplify finance reconciliation.
- DocuSign readiness: once MAP finalized, I'll push a draft SOW + term sheet to DocuSign (link to follow).

Marissa will coordinate the SOW; Olga, please confirm which QBR slot Sarah selects and whether NimbusPay will provide the weekly forecast CSV (Karthik's ask).

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Renewal Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Kim <sarah@nimbuspay.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 16:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — looking to confirm onramp timing and capacity

Hi all — thanks for the quick responses. We can do Wed 2025-05-21 15:00–16:00 PDT. Quick answers:

- We'll commit to providing the weekly forecast CSV by 2025-07-01 and will aim for the 24-month term if the 24-month discount is in the MAP.
- Legal will review a first-pass SOW once Marissa sends it; please cc procurement@nimbuspay.com on the DocuSign thread.
- For the warm-up, Tom confirms they can start a warm-up cohort on 2025-07-29.

Please send the signed MAP and the meeting invite for Wed 5/21 — we'll have our infra and finance leads on the call.

Best,
Sarah
